Project Features :

Bay Square is a commercial complex in Burj Khalifa District, Business Bay, Dubai, offering office and retail spaces with modern finishes and panoramic views of the canal and skyline. With its central location near Sheikh Zayed Road and just minutes from Downtown Dubai and major transport links.

About the Community :

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s leading commercial hubs, strategically located between Downtown Dubai and Sheikh Zayed Road. Designed as a central business district, it offers a mix of high-rise offices, luxury hotels, and residential towers. With excellent transport links, including metro access and proximity to Dubai’s major highways, it’s ideal for companies seeking a prestigious address, modern infrastructure, and close proximity to financial, retail, and lifestyle centers.
